signals.text: 6 open PM roles across 3 US offices

roles.title: Group Product Manager, Retargeting
roles.location: Menlo Park, California, United States; New York, New York, United States; Seattle, Washington, United States

bullets: Ownership of a growing business, with accountability for revenue and advertiser outcomes
Product leadership for targeting, audience creation, re-engagement and retargeting, and the CARA AI optimization models behind them
Deep partnership with machine learning and bidding teams on technically complex systems
A hands-on role in building AI-driven campaign automation across UI and MCP workflows
Cross-functional leadership across a broad, globally distributed organization

roles.title: Director of Product Management, Advertiser Experience
roles.location: Menlo Park, California, United States; New York, New York, United States; Seattle, Washington, United States

bullets: NextGen Ads Manager: an agent-first Ads Manager where agents support advertisers to build, manage, and optimize their campaigns.
Moloco Ads MCP: the agentic interface to Moloco Ads. Advertisers connect their own AI workflows through it.
One agentic platform behind both: every agent workflow runs in Ads Manager and through the MCP on the same components, permissions, and audit trail. An advertiser gets the same…

roles.title: Director of Product Management, CTV
roles.location: Menlo Park, California, United States; Seattle, Washington, United States

bullets: Deliver advertiser experiences that matter: Understand what CTV advertisers need and where they get stuck, then lead teams to build intuitive, indispensable products.
Drive measurable business growth: Own business outcomes such as ad spend, share of wallet, and advertiser performance.
Lead innovation in the market: Spot new opportunities and technical advances in CTV, and keep Moloco ahead of the competition.
Influence across the organization: Be a key voice for the advertiser with leaders across engineering, data science, sales, and marketing, and rally the resources this business…

roles.title: Director of Product Management, Ads Quality and Performance - Moloco Commerce Media

bullets: 10+ years in product management, with a track record of owning a domain end to end, from strategy through shipped, measured outcomes. You are ready to operate as the senior…
Depth in ads quality, ML-driven ranking, bidding, or recommender systems. Large-scale ads ranking, adtech, and commerce search and recommendation are the most direct backgrounds.
Enough technical fluency to earn credibility with ML and data science teams: you help shape the problem framing and stakeholder translation, and contribute points of view on…
Rigor on measurement. You can define outcome metrics and keep proxy metrics from quietly becoming the goal.
Executive communication and the standing to move senior stakeholders across product, engineering, and customer teams.

roles.title: Director of Product Management, Consumer
roles.location: Menlo Park, California, United States; New York, New York, United States; Seattle, Washington, United States

bullets: Own, develop, and execute the product strategy for an end-to-end ads business
Expansion of our technology footprint into a new demand pool
Take new products to market and drive scaled adoption
Identify growth opportunities and build strategic partnerships
Define and drive the product strategy for AI-powered creative generation, optimization, and learning systems.
Define how creative quality, advertiser outcomes, and AI system performance should be measured, evaluated, and optimized.
Partner closely with engineering and machine learning teams to translate emerging technical capabilities into differentiated customer value.
Use customer insights, experimentation, product intuition, and market signals to identify opportunities and guide investment decisions.
Drive product discovery in areas with limited precedent, rapidly testing hypotheses and refining strategy based on new learnings.
